content: Bit 0 of the NetworkStateLIN shall contain the Header Rx No Response state. This is an error that is related to the source frame that is reported in the same data item. The Rx No Response state shall be set to 1 when the LIN controller did not receive the expected LIN frame after transmission of a LIN header. Otherwise it shall be set to 0 .
